# Custom probe (`source_type: custom`)

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-probe-refs.ts from packages/probe-config. Do not edit by hand. -->

Runs a probe function registered by name in the agent's own code. Observer stores only the name and an opaque config object.

- Runs on: an Observer Agent (set the metric's `agent` to its name)
- Thresholds: required when the metric is created (all four fields)
- testProbe: not supported

## Value and unit

- no unit: number returned by the registered probe function, in whatever unit it uses

## source_config fields

| Field | Required | Type | Default | Limits |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `probe_name` | yes | string |  | up to 128 characters |
| `probe_config` | no | object |  |  |
| `timeout_ms` | no | integer |  | 100 to 30000 |

## Rules

- The function must be registered on the agent that runs the metric.
- Cannot be run with testProbe.

## Example

```yaml
source_type: custom
source_config: {"probe_name":"queue-depth","probe_config":{"queue":"emails"}}
```
